title: Fastest browser engine by far at 500 FPS! Servo Webrender - CSS on the GPU part 2: Demo
summary: A demo excerpt from a 2016 Bay Area Rust meetup showing Servo's WebRender drawing CSS on the GPU at very high frame rates. It presents the promise of GPU-based browser rendering.
why: Referenced as the exciting demo that set expectations for Servo and WebRender speedups, later compared with Firefox's real results.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: I was really excited when I saw that demo.
